purpose: Fixed representative lexical-discovery demonstration; questions are not relevance labels, forecasts, allegations or an independent test.

queries.question: Which records distinguish Ministry of Defence DIAV skills or veteran training funding, NSDC Skill India agreements, budget approval, actual payment and placement outcomes?
Which CAG, parliamentary and supplier records distinguish defence offset obligations, discharge claims, accepted fulfilment and penalties in aircraft or arms contracts?
Which PM CARES audited accounts and company filings identify donations, interest, refunds and allocations, and what prevents assigning a donor contribution to a particular contractor?
What smart meter AMISP contract escrow payment waterfall, DISCOM collections and REC finance records distinguish sanction, debt drawdown, service payments and performance deductions?
Which airport concession agreements and AAI records distinguish passenger fees, revenue share, lease proceeds, investment obligations and actual government receipts?
What Bhushan Power and Steel BPSL insolvency and JSW court records distinguish lender debt, resolution consideration, recovery, liquidation and later judicial review or reversal?
Which NDTV VCPL RRPR loan and takeover disclosures, SEBI orders and corrections distinguish a loan, warrants, control rights, ownership and an adverse allegation subsequently narrowed?
Which Delhi Mumbai police Safe City CCTV records distinguish scheme definitions, approved cost, Centre state shares, released funding, expenditure and accepted delivery?
Which PM JAY hospital or Lifeline COVID centre records distinguish empanelment, beneficiary claims, invoices, actual payment, audit objection, alleged onward transfer and court response?
Which UDISE parliamentary school data distinguish state stock counts from individual school closures or mergers, and what matched population, access and funding records are missing?
Which Delhi Jal Board documents distinguish contractor payments from alleged onward receipts and what tribunal, bail or audit responses could contradict the claimed water-contract money trail?
What official inquiry or judicial sources actually attribute a border attack, and why do subsequent defence budgets, procurement benefits or security failures alone not establish a staged attack?

Which welfare DBT scheme audit and utilisation records distinguish allocation, treasury release, beneficiary entitlement, actual receipt, duplicate records, recoveries and ordinary administrative errors?

limits: Purposive cases across existing sectors are not a representative national sample.
Every candidate remains unjudged until its original source and current legal status are reviewed.
No hypothesis probability, expected guilt or forecast accuracy is estimated.
Off-topic and zero-score results will remain in the raw rankings.
